title: Workplace Cafe Management Program: Meal Subsidy Terms by Service Model
content:
Each service model of the Workplace Cafe Management Program carries its own client subsidy terms, fixing the minimum annual client subsidy committed, how that subsidy reaches the employee at the counter, and the ceilings, funding and rollover conditions that govern it.

### Terms

- Minimum annual client subsidy: the minimum annual meal subsidy the client commits to fund for the service model, in USD per contract year.
- Subsidy model: how the client subsidy reaches the employee, one of none, percent discount, fixed amount per meal or full.
- Subsidy percentage of menu price: the percentage of the menu price met by client subsidy under a percent discount subsidy model.
- Daily cap per employee: the ceiling on subsidy drawn for one employee on one service day, in USD.
- Funding lot minimum: the smallest single subsidy funding lot the client may pay in, in USD.
- Funding lot expiry: the months a funding lot stays drawable before it expires, in whole months.
- Unused rollover: the percentage of an expiring lot that rolls into the next funding lot rather than lapsing.
- Guest meal surcharge: the surcharge added to a non-employee guest meal, in USD.

### Schedule

| Service model | Min annual client subsidy (USD) | Subsidy model | Subsidy pct of menu price (per cent) | Daily cap per employee (USD) | Funding lot minimum (USD) | Funding lot expiry (months) | Unused rollover (per cent) | Guest meal surcharge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grab & Go Cafe Service | 18000.00 USD | none | 0 per cent | 0.00 USD | 1500.00 USD | 6 months | 0 per cent | 3.75 USD |
| Limited Service Cafe | 46500.00 USD | percent discount | 15 per cent | 4.50 USD | 3800.00 USD | 9 months | 25 per cent | 4.50 USD |
| Full Service Cafe | 128000.00 USD | percent discount | 25 per cent | 7.25 USD | 9500.00 USD | 12 months | 50 per cent | 6.25 USD |
| Culinary Center Cafe | 275000.00 USD | fixed amount per meal | 0 per cent | 9.00 USD | 21000.00 USD | 12 months | 75 per cent | 8.50 USD |
| Executive Dining Service | 340000.00 USD | full | 100 per cent | 24.00 USD | 26500.00 USD | 18 months | 100 per cent | 15.00 USD |
| Campus Dining Commons Service | 620000.00 USD | percent discount | 35 per cent | 11.50 USD | 47500.00 USD | 12 months | 60 per cent | 7.00 USD |

### Distinguishing Note

The subsidy model itself changes shape across service models: no client subsidy is drawn against the menu price under Grab & Go Cafe Service, a percent discount is applied under Limited Service Cafe, Full Service Cafe and Campus Dining Commons Service, a fixed amount per meal is applied under Culinary Center Cafe, and the full menu price is met by client subsidy under Executive Dining Service. The daily cap per employee, the funding lot minimum and the unused rollover percentage all widen as the service model tier rises.

### Hypothetical Selection Illustration

Consider a hypothetical client that holds the cafe management contract for a site under the Limited Service Cafe model and commits the minimum annual client subsidy of 46500.00 USD fixed for that model. Under the percent discount subsidy model printed against Limited Service Cafe, that client's subsidy meets 15 per cent of the menu price at the counter, subject to a daily cap per employee of 4.50 USD, with a funding lot minimum of 3800.00 USD, a funding lot expiry of 9 months, and an unused rollover of 25 per cent.
